svg.title: Human LLM Council
svg.desc: Human LLM Council. An LLM that thinks and decides like one person, and runs on consumer-grade hardware. Four members sit round a table: the Scrutiniser, being built first, and the planned Designer, Coder and Orchestrator. Each in turn passes its suggestion to the person at the head of the table, who decides. A typed line cycles: tested on my latest 375 real decisions; also scored on the 53 times I overrode it; pass mark fixed before any training; built for a laptop GPU; my data stays home.
